summary: Perusahaan Perseroan Persero PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk filed a Form 6-K disclosing a delay in the submission of its Annual Report, Sustainability Report, and Q1 2026 Financial Statements due to an ongoing audit by the Public Accounting Firm. The delay is expected to be cured by May 15, 2026 (NT 20-F deadline) and May 31, 2026 respectively. The filing notes no material impact on business continuity. This is a routine reporting compliance notice, not a special situation event. No deal terms, adviser, or shareholder action is implicated. The filing is mapped to a US NT 20-F equivalent for delayed annual report filing.
